Cat Simulator

Cat Simulator is a simulation game that lets players live life as a mischievous feline. Roam across large maps, cause complete chaos by knocking things over, hunt small mice, and complete rewarding neighborhood quests.
SHOW MORE

Cat Simulator is an adorable game where you play as a mischievous little cat! Explore cozy rooms, interact with all kinds of objects, pull playful pranks, and knock things over just for fun. Jump around, collect stars, and unlock new rooms to continue your curious adventure. Ready to cause some cute chaos?

How to play Cat Simulator?
Move: WASD or the arrow keys
Jump: the space bar
